Vendor pages now come straight from the game's trader data instead of a hand-typed list, so Valheim Data finally shows everything Haldor, Hildir and the Bog Witch actually sell in 1.0. New on Haldor's shelf: Wider Pockets (1000 coins, after Moder) and Deeper Pockets (2000 coins, after The Queen) - one extra inventory row each, bought once per character. The Bog Witch's Seasoning of the Gourd (after Kall Fimbulbringer) and Crown of Roots (after a Writhan kill) are now listed as her stock with the right biomes rather than as world pickups.

Every trader item shows its unlock ("Defeat Moder", "Return Hildir's Brass Chest") and how many the price buys ("10 coins for 20" bait). Item pages say who sells them; the two Pockets have their own pages under Misc > Vendor Upgrade.
